import math

TAU_S = 0.03
SLEW_MW_S = 50.0
MAX_STEP_6S = 9.85
MAX_STEP_60S = 19.7
SOC_KP = 0.02
SOC_TARGET = 0.50

def control(obs: dict) -> dict[str, float]:
    p_raw = float(obs["p_raw_mw"])
    rated = float(obs["rated_mw"])
    dt = float(obs["dt"])
    soc = float(obs["soc"])
    b_max = float(obs["battery_max_power_mw"])
    cap = float(obs["battery_capacity_mwh"])
    e = float(obs["battery_energy_mwh"])
    idle = float(obs.get("idle_mw", obs["p_prev_grid_mw"]))
    st = obs["state"]

    if "pg" not in st:
        b_dt = max(dt, 0.1)
        n60 = int(round(60.0 / b_dt)) + 1
        st["b_dt"] = b_dt
        st["n60"] = n60
        st["n6"] = int(round(6.0 / b_dt)) + 1
        st["mins"] = [idle] * n60
        st["maxs"] = [idle] * n60
        st["idx"] = 0
        st["acc_t"] = 0.0
        st["y1"] = idle
        st["y2"] = idle
        st["pg"] = idle

    if p_raw <= idle + 2.0 and soc < 0.85:
        desired = min(rated, p_raw + b_max * 0.5)
    else:
        desired = min(rated, max(0.0, p_raw + SOC_KP * (SOC_TARGET - soc) * b_max))

    alpha = dt / (TAU_S + dt)
    st["y1"] = (1.0 - alpha) * st["y1"] + alpha * desired
    st["y2"] = (1.0 - alpha) * st["y2"] + alpha * st["y1"]

    max_d = SLEW_MW_S * dt
    p_target = st["pg"] + max(-max_d, min(max_d, st["y2"] - st["pg"]))

    n60, n6, idx = st["n60"], st["n6"], st["idx"]
    mins, maxs = st["mins"], st["maxs"]
    min60, max60 = min(mins), max(maxs)
    if idx >= n6 - 1:
        min6 = min(mins[idx - n6 + 1 : idx + 1])
        max6 = max(maxs[idx - n6 + 1 : idx + 1])
    else:
        rem = n6 - 1 - idx
        min6 = min(min(mins[: idx + 1]), min(mins[n60 - rem :]))
        max6 = max(max(maxs[: idx + 1]), max(maxs[n60 - rem :]))

    lo = max(0.0, max6 - MAX_STEP_6S, max60 - MAX_STEP_60S)
    hi = min(rated, min6 + MAX_STEP_6S, min60 + MAX_STEP_60S)
    p_target = max(lo, min(hi, p_target))
    st["pg"] = p_target

    st["acc_t"] += dt
    if st["acc_t"] >= st["b_dt"] - 1e-9:
        st["acc_t"] = 0.0
        idx = (idx + 1) % n60
        st["idx"] = idx
        mins[idx] = p_target
        maxs[idx] = p_target
    else:
        if p_target < mins[idx]: mins[idx] = p_target
        if p_target > maxs[idx]: maxs[idx] = p_target

    dt_h = dt / 3600.0
    eta = math.sqrt(0.90)
    b_dis_max = min(b_max, max(0.0, (e - 0.1 * cap) * eta / dt_h))
    b_chg_max = min(b_max, max(0.0, (0.9 * cap - e) / (eta * dt_h)))
    if p_target < p_raw - b_dis_max:
        return {"gpu_floor_mw": 0.0, "gpu_cap_mw": p_target + b_dis_max, "battery_setpoint_mw": b_dis_max}
    if p_target > p_raw + b_chg_max:
        return {"gpu_floor_mw": p_target - b_chg_max, "gpu_cap_mw": rated, "battery_setpoint_mw": -b_chg_max}
    return {"gpu_floor_mw": 0.0, "gpu_cap_mw": rated, "battery_setpoint_mw": p_raw - p_target}
